name: vinoozy-tooling
description: Pinned Node tooling for Vinoozy: Firebase Emulator Suite, Firestore security rules tests and the account deletion web page (bundle and tests). No global installs.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-vinoozy "npm --prefix test/rules test -- u1.rules.test.mjs u7.rules.test.mjs u4.rules.test.mjs u8.rules.test.mjs compat/"
scripts.test:web: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-vinoozy "c8 --check-coverage --lines 80 --include docs/account-deletion/account-deletion.js --reporter text --reporter lcov --report-dir coverage/web node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/web/*.test.mjs"
